title: Synonymix: Unified Group Personas for Generative Simulations
reasoning: The paper focuses on a pipeline for creating privacy-preserving group personas for agent simulations. While it uses survey items from the General Social Survey (GSS) that include attitudes on religious and moral topics (e.g., abortion, suicide) to evaluate behavioral signal preservation, the primary research goal is the development of the 'unigraph' methodology and its privacy properties, not the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, or ethics itself.
